ordinary_source_candidate_summary: Fourteen list-observation matches could be clarified by renaming the local requests list in9nonheld source files; this is optional naming clarity, not a reproduced vulnerability fix. No edits authorized or made. Replacing protocol hashes, hiding calls behind aliases, rewriting frozen evidence, removing rules/targets, or changing trusted-operator choices merely to silence findings is not proposed.
smallest_policy_decision: The existing responsible security-policy owner must decide whether each independently checked exact source/rule/context case can be classified inapplicable under the repository gate. Technical triage alone supplies no authority. Enabling exit1 acceptance through a map/pin is a separate explicit policy/criteria authorization; latest no-security-change instruction means keep inactive unless that exact authorization is given. Unknown/changed cases, errors/skips/coverage failures remain blocking.
